rationale: M60 LUA-01/LUA-13/LUA-22, authored from M59 (#825)'s line rule — the line is where the NAME is written — not from the analyzer's output. The multi-line call is the falsifier: a whole-line implementation reports the RECEIVER's line and passes every other row in this file, so it is the row that distinguishes the two rules. LUA-22's forbidden row is a payload-as-a-name, the defect class M60 records for other lanes. Line numbers are MEASURED from this committed file.
